chunks: And with this chain of narrators, it was said that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

Beware of the doors of the ruler and his confidants, for the closer you are to the doors of the ruler and his confidants, the further you are from Allah, the Exalted. And whoever prefers the ruler over Allah, Allah will remove piety (war') from him and make him confused/perplexed.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual consequence of getting close to unjust rulers according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq highlights the spiritual danger of seeking proximity to unjust rulers, noting that physical closeness to the throne often correlates with spiritual distance from Allah. This hadith underscores the Shia concept of *war'* (piety/conscientiousness), warning that prioritizing political favor over divine command results in the loss of moral clarity and leads to existential perplexity.
